question:
Study the table below showing the research papers published by five institutions over four years and answer the question.

Year | Inst X | Inst Y | Inst Z | Inst W | Inst V
2019 | 120 | 95 | 110 | 80 | 105
201 | 135 | 100 | 125 | 90 | 115
2021 | 150 | 110 | 140 | 105 | 125
2022 | 165 | 125 | 155 | 120 | 140

Q. For Institution Z, what is the percentage increase in research papers published from 2019 to 2022?
explanation: Papers published by Inst Z in 2019 = 110, in 2022 = 155. Increase = 155 - 110 = 45. Percentage increase = (45 / 110) * 100 = 40.909% ≈ 40.91%. Option A uses a wrong denominator or numerator.

question:
Study the table below showing the tickets sold by a cinema on seven days of a week and answer the question.

Day | Gold Tickets | Silver Tickets | Balcony Tickets
Monday | 150 | 300 | 100
Tuesday | 120 | 250 | 90
Wednesday | 130 | 280 | 95
Thursday | 140 | 290 | 110
Friday | 200 | 450 | 150
Saturday | 350 | 600 | 250
Sunday | 400 | 650 | 300

Q. What is the ratio of total Gold tickets sold to total Balcony tickets sold across the entire week?
explanation: Total Gold tickets = 150 + 120 + 130 + 140 + 200 + 350 + 400 = 1490. Total Balcony tickets = 100 + 90 + 95 + 110 + 150 + 250 + 300 = 1095. Ratio = 1490 : 1095 = 298 : 219, which simplifies to 29 : 21 (approx). Option A is the reciprocal.

question:
Study the table below showing foreign tourist arrivals (in thousands) by quarter over three years and answer the question.

Year | Q1 | Q2 | Q3 | Q4
2021 | 40 | 30 | 50 | 80
2022 | 60 | 45 | 75 | 120
2023 | 80 | 60 | 100 | 160

Q. Which quarter recorded the highest total foreign tourist arrivals across all three years combined?
explanation: Total arrivals by quarter: Q1 = 40+60+80 = 180; Q2 = 30+45+60 = 135; Q3 = 50+75+100 = 225; Q4 = 80+120+160 = 360. Q4 has the highest total arrivals. Option C is correct.

2022 | 60 | 45 | 75 | 120

प्र. सभी तीन वर्षों को मिलाकर किस तिमाही में विदेशी पर्यटकों का कुल आगमन सबसे अधिक दर्ज किया गया?
explanation_hi: तिमाही के अनुसार कुल आगमन: Q1 = 180; Q2 = 135; Q3 = 225; Q4 = 360। Q4 में आगमन सबसे अधिक है। विकल्प C सही है।

question:
Study the table below showing foreign tourist arrivals (in thousands) by quarter over three years and answer the question.

Year | Q1 | Q2 | Q3 | Q4
2021 | 40 | 30 | 50 | 80
2022 | 60 | 45 | 75 | 120
2023 | 80 | 60 | 100 | 160

Q. What is the ratio of total tourist arrivals in Q2 across all years to the total tourist arrivals in Q4 across all years?
explanation: Total Q2 arrivals = 30 + 45 + 60 = 135. Total Q4 arrivals = 80 + 120 + 160 = 360. Ratio = 135 : 360. Dividing by 45 gives 3 : 8. Option D is correct.
question_hi:

2021 | 40 | 30 | 50 | 80
2022 | 60 | 45 | 75 | 120
2023 | 80 | 60 | 100 | 160

प्र. सभी वर्षों में Q2 में कुल पर्यटक आगमन का सभी वर्षों में Q4 में कुल पर्यटक आगमन से अनुपात क्या है?
explanation_hi: Q2 का कुल आगमन = 135। Q4 का कुल आगमन = 360। अनुपात = 135 : 360 = 3 : 8। विकल्प D सही है।

question:
Study the table below representing the percentage share of various cost components in publishing a book (total 100%) and answer the question.

Cost Component | Percentage Share (%)
Paper | 25%
Printing | 20%
Binding | 15%
Royalty | 15%
Promotion | 10%
Transportation | 15%

Q. In a pie chart representing this data, what angle (in degrees) will the 'Printing' cost component subtend at the centre?
explanation: To convert a percentage into degrees, multiply the percentage by 3.6 (since 100% corresponds to 360°). For Printing, the share is 20%. Angle = 20 * 3.6 = 72°. Option A is correct.
question_hi:
नीचे दी गई तालिका का अध्ययन करें जो एक पुस्तक के प्रकाशन में विभिन्न लागत घटकों (कुल 100%) के प्रतिशत हिस्से को दर्शाती है और प्रश्न का उत्तर दें।

लागत घटक | प्रतिशत हिस्सा (%)
पेपर | 25%
मुद्रण (Printing) | 20%
बाइंडिंग | 15%
रॉयल्टी | 15%
प्रचार (Promotion) | 10%
परिवहन (Transportation) | 15%

प्र. इस डेटा का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाले पाई चार्ट में, 'मुद्रण' लागत घटक केंद्र पर कौन सा कोण (डिग्री में) बनाएगा?
explanation_hi: प्रतिशत को डिग्री में बदलने के लिए, 3.6 से गुणा करें। 'मुद्रण' का हिस्सा 20% है। कोण = 20 * 3.6 = 72°। विकल्प A सही है।
